rows.label: Corporate income tax (Körperschaftsteuer) [national]
rows.value: 15% up to 2027, then 14%, 13%, 12%, 11%, 10% in 2028 to 2032, plus 5.5% solidarity surcharge on the tax. Paid by companies resident in Germany and non-resident companies on German income. Körperschaftsteuergesetz § 23; Solidaritätszuschlaggesetz § 4. In force from 1 January 2008.

source.title: § 23 Körperschaftsteuergesetz (KStG) Steuersatz (gesetze-im-internet.de; KStG last amended by Art. 30 G v. 4.2.2026 I Nr. 33)

rows.label: Minimum tax on large corporate groups (Mindeststeuer) [national]
rows.value: top-up to 15% effective tax for groups with revenue of €750,000,000 or more. Paid by German entities of in-scope groups. Mindeststeuergesetz §§ 1, 54. In force from 31 December 2023.

source.title: Mindeststeuergesetz (MinStG) vom 21.12.2023, §§ 1, 2, 54 and 101 (gesetze-im-internet.de; last amended by Art. 1 G v. 22.12.2025 I Nr. 353)

rows.label: Trade tax (Gewerbesteuer) [municipal]
rows.value: 3.5% of trade income × the municipal multiplier (at least 200% in 2026, 280% from 2027; average 410% in 2025). Paid by businesses and companies (not freelancers). Gewerbesteuergesetz §§ 11, 16.

source.title: § 16 Gewerbesteuergesetz (GewStG) Hebesatz, § 11 Steuermesszahl and § 36 (5b) Zeitlicher Anwendungsbereich (gesetze-im-internet.de; GewStG last amended by Art. 8 G v. 29.6.2026 I Nr. 197)

rows.label: Tax on distributed profits (Kapitalertragsteuer) and branch profits [national]
rows.value: 25% withheld on dividends plus solidarity surcharge (two fifths refunded to non-resident companies); no branch profits tax found. Paid by shareholders (withheld by the paying company). Einkommensteuergesetz §§ 43, 43a, 44a.

source.title: § 43a Einkommensteuergesetz (EStG) Bemessung der Kapitalertragsteuer; § 44a Abs. 9 Abstandnahme vom Steuerabzug (gesetze-im-internet.de; EStG last amended by Art. 1 G v. 15.10.2026 I Nr. 307)

rows.label: Self-employed contributions: pension, health and long-term care insurance [national]
rows.value: pension 18.6% for compulsorily insured groups only (standard €735.63 a month); health insurance compulsory for all residents, minimum base €1,318.33 a month. Paid by the self-employed. SGB VI §§ 2, 165; SGB V § 240; VVG § 193. In force from 1 January 2026.

source.title: Deutsche Rentenversicherung: Werte der Rentenversicherung (Stand 01.07.2026); § 165 SGB VI Beitragspflichtige Einnahmen selbständig Tätiger

rows.label: Contractor rules: employment status test, § 50a and construction withholding [national]
rows.value: status test of § 7 SGB IV with the DRV status procedure; 15% withholding on non-residents' performance and royalty fees (30% on supervisory-board fees); 15% construction withholding. Paid by clients (withheld by the payer). SGB IV §§ 7, 7a; Einkommensteuergesetz §§ 48, 50a.

source.title: § 7 SGB IV Beschäftigung; § 1 Lohnsteuer-Durchführungsverordnung (LStDV) Arbeitnehmer, Arbeitgeber (gesetze-im-internet.de)

rows.label: Simplified regimes: small-business VAT exemption and cash-basis accounting [national]
rows.value: no VAT up to €25,000 turnover in the previous year and €100,000 in the current year; cash-basis profit for those not required to keep books (traders up to €800,000 turnover or €80,000 profit); no presumptive income tax. Paid by small businesses and freelancers who use them. Umsatzsteuergesetz § 19; Einkommensteuergesetz § 4 (3); Abgabenordnung § 141.

source.title: § 141 Abgabenordnung (AO) Buchführungspflicht bestimmter Steuerpflichtiger; § 4 (3) EStG (gesetze-im-internet.de)

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (beschränkte Steuerpflicht) [national]
rows.value: income tax on the normal tariff, withheld as wage tax in class I, on pay for work done in Germany; basic allowance only up to the German pay. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). Einkommensteuergesetz §§ 1 (4), 38b, 49 (1) no. 4, 50; Abgabenordnung §§ 8, 9.

source.title: § 1 EStG Steuerpflicht; § 49 (1) Nr. 4 EStG Beschränkt steuerpflichtige Einkünfte (gesetze-im-internet.de)

Paid by property owners. Grundsteuergesetz §§ 10, 15, 25 and the Land property tax laws. In force from 1 January 2025.
